name: @funcd/example-workflow
description: A five-step funcd Workflow example (ADR-0094): ingest → score → {hi | lo, exclusive via when} → report (join: any). Each step is an ordinary contract-bearing TypeScript function; the Workflow materializes them into owned Functions the engine drives. Authored against @funcd/shim-nodejs; build.ts bakes each step's contract and emits <step>.mjs + <step>.schema.json.
